HELD DISABLED — THE ROUNDING VERDICT IS ABOUT ROWS THAT CANNOT BE CHECKED AT ALL. The probe reported NO RULE EXPLAINS IT for this location, and the residual list says why: alongside the ordinary -0.75c and -0.25c there are residuals of SEVENTY THOUSAND CENTS. This board quotes `Canola USD/CWT (cwt)` -- US dollars per hundredweight -- against ICE Canada canola in CANADIAN DOLLARS PER TONNE. lib/board.mjs already records exactly this, measured at CHS Hallock and Oklee on 2026-08-26 and out by 70,574 cents. cash minus basis cannot equal a quote when the three are not in the same unit, let alone the same money.

So the arithmetic is almost certainly: withhold the canola rows with `foreignQuote` and the wheat rows floor to the cent like every other CHS board probed tonight. `foreignQuote` is declared here and matches the commodity prefix, which lib/board.mjs learned to do earlier tonight for Border Ag.

IT IS STILL HELD, and standing rule 15 is why: when a probe declines to state a rule, believe it. The probe judged the whole board; this file changes which rows the board HAS. That is a different question and it has not been measured. One poll settles it -- a refusal would be loud and would take nothing else down. Enable it when somebody has decided to.

NO COORDINATE AND NO STATE. The Bushel payload carries neither, and "Havre" did not match a town this repo already holds. It will publish bids and will not appear on the distance-sorted map until somebody places it. That is the correct order: a bid with no pin is honest, a pin in the wrong county is not.

address, zip and phone are null. The payload has a location name and a UUID; those are lookups, not measurements.
